name: Bone Fragments
label: Quest
description: Bone Fragments: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, friend. Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My dream of becoming a full-time dancer at the Gadgetzan disco is soon to become a reality! Keep up the good work, friend.
